notes: Worker-level evals: each runs the per-type skill a /spec-sweep worker uses on one real bloated spec. Graded by probes/*.tsv mutation kills (fixed set per eval), coverage, size, smells, green, app/ untouched.

evals.name: mse-service-trim
evals.prompt: spec/services/mental_status_exam_validation_service_spec.rb is ~1300 lines for a ~370 line service. Trim the fat and make sure what's left actually tests the service for real. Don't commit.
evals.expected_output: Much shorter green spec; every validation rule, boundary and sentinel still guarded; no constructor/constant/type-only fat; app/ untouched.

evals.name: button-component-trim
evals.prompt: Clean up spec/components/button_component_spec.rb - it's 1000+ lines, mostly class-name checks. I want it to test what the button actually does. Don't commit.
evals.expected_output: Shorter green spec asserting rendered behavior (element kind, href/turbo data, disabled, confirm, sr-only label, caller options not mutated, variant mapping once); app/ untouched.

evals.name: invoice-policy-review
evals.prompt: Review spec/policies/invoice_policy_spec.rb and make it good - trim the fat and make sure it really guards who can touch invoices. Don't commit.
evals.expected_output: Compact role grid using real roles, scope asserts inclusion and exclusion, no cross-org/delegation padding; every role-widening/narrowing probe killed.

evals.name: token-service-write
evals.prompt: app/services/form_access_token_service.rb has no specs at all. Write them. Don't commit.
evals.expected_output: New lean spec guarding expiry (incl. nil expiry), the 5-attempt limit, attempt recording, custom expiration, attempt reset on regenerate, token entropy, invalid-input guards; no constructor/ivar/type-only padding.
